rationale: The workflow is a single-job build trigger that checks out code and runs ./.ci/dev-build with a repository-scoped token. None of the evidence-supported patterns have preconditions that are clearly met: there is no dependency installation to cache (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), no matrix to apply fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no schedule to suppress (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), no test suite to prioritize or select (P-LIT-PRIORITIZE/P-LIT-SELECT), no Bazel build to tune (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), no CI history for history-based timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT/P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT), and no outputs or configuration to eliminate/reuse. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is the closest candidate, but it is simulation-estimate evidence, the workflow triggers a development build (potentially release/deployment work, a listed contraindication), required checks are unverified, and it is unclear whether newer revisions supersede older checks for this trigger. Applying an unsupported change risks altering required-check behavior without evidence of benefit.
